OUR STORY

A home, turned into a table

Cafe Auberge is Jaipur's home cafe — an intimate, chef-driven dining room set inside a lived-in Civil Lines house, where every corner still feels like someone's living room. The kitchen leads the experience here, with a menu that moves easily between Rajasthani classics, global comfort food and an all-day café spread.

Jaipur's favourite home cafe 🤍

MENU

Our Menu

From slow-cooked House of Bhinder classics to hand-tossed pizza and crafted coffee — the full Cafe Auberge menu, all in one place.

CHEF DRIVEN EXPERIENCE

Every dish, considered

From soups to slow-cooked mutton, pasta to biryani — the kitchen at Cafe Auberge takes the same care across an unusually wide table, so the menu reads like a home cook's, not a hotel's.
